composition_subtypes.role: Sort prices ascending to enable greedy selection of cheapest most-expensive item
Iterate prefix sizes and greedily add next k-cheapest items as a group

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort prices ascending; then try k+1 prefix sizes for individual buys, then greedily extend with k-groups.
payload.rationale: Solution uses sorting preprocessing to enable a greedy strategy that tries all possible numbers of items bought without discount, then greedily adds groups of k items. No DP or complex state.
